# What a user does and sees (compat/apps.rs): each case after its tap.
platform linux terminal
# mod-device-terminal
tap id:case-mod-device-terminal
expect OS: linux
expect Idiom: terminal
expect Select: desktop
prop id:bar desktop.windowDrag true
covers [nsh] platform
# base-select-placeholder
tap id:case-base-select-placeholder
# Nothing chosen and no `trigger`: the terminal's trigger says the app's
# placeholder, and screen readers hear it as the trigger's value.
expect Choose a team
prop label:Team accessibilityValue text=Choose a team
# The app's `trigger` is shown as the app made it.
expect Owner: Build team
covers [props] placeholder
